messages:
lina_cs: CS here — multiple customers reporting repeated 5xx + client-side reconnect loops to hosted inference endpoints in us-west-2. Started ~09:12 UTC, high P50/P90 latency before 500s. Sample ticket ID #12345, #12347. Escalating to incident thread.

devon: ack. Oncall pinged. Can someone paste the earliest gateway logs?

ops-bot: Alert: hosted-api-us-west-2: increased 5xx rate (10m window) — 1.8% -> 12.4%. Spike detected at 2026-03-17T09:12:40Z.

maya_sre: I'm looking. Initial quick check — gateway p95 to runtime jumped to ~2.1s right before errors. Could be runtime saturation or an upstream keepalive/conn reset pattern.

devon: grabbing gateway logs. snippet: ```2026-03-17T09:12:38Z ERROR gateway request_id=abc123 upstream_err="timeout after 10s" route=/v1/generate```

samir_infra: Runtime pool CPU/GPU metrics show a modest CPU spike but not OOM. However KV-cache hit rate dropped from 92% -> 10% at the same time window. That could cause extra compute and timeouts.

alex_platform: Any recent deploys or config changes in us-west-2?

devon: No prod deploys in the 30m window. We had a config PR to the proxy keepalive earlier today but scheduled for later — not deployed.

maya_sre: Immediate mitigation proposal: 1) Enable fallback routing for affected routes to the smaller-model variant (failover) 2) Temporarily increase runtime concurrency and add capacity 3) Re-enable KV-cache warmup for high-traffic tenants. Which is fastest?

alex_platform: We can flip the route fallback knob in the control plane now (:gear:). Rolling fallback to model-mini for `/v1/generate` for tenant-acme first.

lina_cs: Please do tenant-by-tenant to avoid global perf hit. ACME is top-affected. Customers on ACME reported >30% failed requests.

devon: I've pushed the fallback policy for tenant-acme. Command used: ```curl -X POST https://control.redwood.internal/v1/routes/fallback -d '{"tenant":"acme","route":"/v1/generate","fallback":"model-mini"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'```

ops-bot: Action logged: fallback applied to tenant acme by devon at 2026-03-17T09:16:05Z.

samir_infra: Also applied a soft scale up of the dedicated pool (api-runtime-usw2) by +2 nodes. Autoscaler accepted target.

maya_sre: After actions: KV-cache hit rate recovered to ~85% within 2 minutes and 5xx rate reduced to 1.9%. Latency p95 back to ~400ms. Looks like cache cold/warmup was primary.

alex_platform: Good. Can we add a short-term synthetic warmup for top tenants when code path invalidates cache? Maybe pre-warm entries on deploy/scale.

devon: Noted. I'll open an engineering ticket for smarter cache warmup and an automatic detection rule for KV-degradation.

lina_cs: CS update sent to customers: we applied fallback and extra capacity, monitoring. Asking impacted customers for request IDs/examples to validate. :white_check_mark:

maya_sre: Action items (short-term):
- devon: create ENG ticket for KV warmup automation + detection rule (JIRA TBD)
- samir_infra: investigate why cache miss storm occurred (possible eviction cascade) and produce RCA notes by EOD
- alex_platform: add control-plane guardrail to do tenant-targeted fallbacks only and document rollback steps
- maya_sre: follow up with CS for customer verification and rollback plan after warmup

devon: created ENG-2147 (placeholder) — short description: "KV-cache miss storms cause runtime spike and 5xx; automation for warmup/detection".

samir_infra: started collecting heap/eviction logs and TTL metrics, dumping samples to /var/tmp/kvcache-dump-975310.

lina_cs: Thanks team. I'll keep customers updated. Marking this thread for postmortem and action tracking.

maya_sre: Postmortem notes to include: timeline, mitigation steps (fallback + scale), root cause hypothesis (kvcache invalidation/eviction cascade), and owners for follow-ups. Recommend a runbook addendum for cache warmup and per-tenant fallback thresholds.

devon: Quick post-incident checklist: capture exact request_ids for failed requests, snapshot gateway/runtime configs at time of error, attach graphs (p95/p99, kv hits, inflight).

lina_cs: I'll compile tickets and send summary to #all-hands and link the postmortem doc once ENG-2147 has an owner.

ops-bot: Incident resolved: 5xx rate returned to baseline at 2026-03-17T09:18:40Z.

maya_sre: Follow-up note (2026-03-18): Samir please share RCA draft. We'll schedule 30m retro tomorrow 09:30 UTC.

samir_infra: RCA draft uploaded to google drive (link: https://drive.internal/rca/975310). Initial findings: eviction storm due to TTL misconfiguration plus higher cold-start traffic after a tenant batch job. Will expand.

lina_cs: Closing thread for now. Postmortem will have final action owners and timelines. :memo:
